title: Canonical Lattices of Integer Relations Associated to Rational Fans: Wall Generation and a Two-Step Support Filtration
summary: We study the lattice $L_{\mathrm{rel}}(Σ)=\ker\big(\mathbb{Z}^{Σ(1)}\to N\big)$ of integer relations among the primitive ray generators of a rational fan $Σ$, from an intrinsic, coordinate-free point of view.
